articles.title: Malaysia seeks over US$251 million in compensation from Norwegian firm over scrapped missile deal
articles.summary: Malaysia is seeking over US$251 million from Norway's Kongsberg Maritime. This follows the revocation of export licenses for the Naval Strike Missile system. articles.title: Expert Says Not To Panic, But Surveillance Is Crucial
